newsitem.title: GREECE: GEK SEES 96 PRETAX PROFIT UP 13.9PCT.
newsitem.headline: GEK SEES 96 PRETAX PROFIT UP 13.9PCT.

text.p: Greek General Construction Company (GEK), said it expected 1996 pretax profits at 2.83 billion drachmas, up 13.9 percent from 2.48 billion in 1995, GEK executives told institutional investors on Wednesday.
The company also expects its 1996 consolidated turnover to increase 30.1 percent, to 14.9 billion drachmas from 11.4 billion in 1995.
GEK's uncompleted project backlog for 1997 and 1998 is 30 billion drachmas of which 68 percent accounts for public projects. --Athens Newsroom + 301 3311812-4
